pain_point: Commute and location concerns - I need something close to the freeway and port — Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?
headline_outcome: The West Is Where Growth Is
primary_text: "Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?" Ask yourself this: would you rather rent a cramped inner-west unit or own a brand-new warehouse on the freeway for the same monthly cost? Melbourne's industrial heartbeat has shifted west. The infrastructure is here — Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and port access. The growth is here — land values in Truganina's industrial precinct have climbed steadily. The only thing missing is your business. These off-the-plan warehouses are designed for small business owners ready to stop renting and start owning. Limited units remain in this release.
description: Own for the same monthly cost as renting in the inner west
